model_annotation: The figure contains two line plots showing training rewards over optimization steps for two methods on an easy training set (top) and a hard training set (bottom). In both plots, the x-axis is labeled “Steps,” uses a linear scale, and runs from 0 to 500 with major ticks at 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, and 500. The y-axis in both plots is labeled “Training Rewards” on a linear scale; in the top plot it spans roughly 0.0 to 0.4 with labeled ticks at 0.0, 0.2, and 0.4, and in the bottom plot it spans roughly 0.0 to 0.2 with labeled ticks at 0.0, 0.1, and 0.2. In the “Easy Training Set” plot, a blue solid line (Llama-On-Policy-Easy) starts near 0.0 at step 0, rises to about 0.25 by around 100 steps, reaches roughly 0.33–0.36 around 200–300 steps, and ends near about 0.35–0.37 by step 500; a red solid line (Llama-LUFFY-Easy) starts near 0.0, increases to about 0.22–0.25 by around 100 steps, continues upward with fluctuations to around 0.33–0.36 by about 300 steps, and finishes near about 0.40–0.42 at step 500. In the “Hard Training Set” plot, a blue solid line (Llama-On-Policy-Hard) begins around 0.02–0.03 at step 0, declines toward approximately 0.0 by roughly 80–120 steps, and remains near 0.0 through the remainder of the shown steps (to 500); a red solid line (Llama-LUFFY-Hard) starts near 0.0, rises to about 0.10 by around 50–100 steps, increases with small oscillations to roughly 0.14–0.16 by about 200–300 steps, and ends near about 0.20–0.21 at step 500.
